title: Bill Miller's investing strategy: How the legendary fund manager outperformed the market for 15 straight years
description: Bill Miller beat the S&P 500 for 15 consecutive years by combining value investing, long-term patience and contrarian thinking. His strategy focuses on intrinsic value, free cash flow, margin of safety and exploiting market overreactions while holding stocks until they reach fair value or the investment thesis changes.

title: Utkarsh Small Finance Bank posts Rs 34 crore Q1 loss; asset quality stress persists
description: Utkarsh Small Finance Bank reported a net loss of Rs 34 crore for the June quarter, marking its fifth consecutive quarterly loss, as elevated asset quality stress continued to weigh on its performance. While the loss narrowed significantly on lower provisions, the lender's gross non-performing assets remained high at 6.1%.

title: Muthoot Finance reports 25% rise in Q1 profit, announces leadership transition

The company also announced a leadership transition, with Alexander George Muthoot set to take over as managing director from October 1, subject to shareholder approval.

title: Real estate firm Assetz files IPO papers with Sebi via confidential route; plans Rs 1,200 cr issue

The firm aims to secure around Rs 1,200 crore as it ventures into public markets. With ambitious plans for land acquisition and a keen interest in expanding to the Mumbai Metropolitan Region, this step marks a crucial milestone in Assetz Ltd's growth trajectory.

title: FPIs reverse 4-month selling trend with Rs 20,200 cr inflow in July

The future of these investments hinges on both global market conditions and domestic economic indicators.
